protocol.latency_quantile_definition: linear quantile ((n-1)*p) of per-query median-repetition ns
protocol.primary_test: exact two-sided McNemar for F vs FANNG at primary cap, Holm across graphs
protocol.parameter_selection: none; all requested cells required and reported
protocol.scope: FANNG search port on fixed HNSW graphs, not full FANNG index reproduction
